SMTP 521 Reply Code

findings.rationale: RFC7504 (published 2015-06) formally incorporates the 521 reply code into SMTP, superseding RFC1846's experimental definition. The evidence shows RFC7504 explicitly states the 521 code 'was originally described in an Experimental RFC in 1995' but 'has not previously been formally incorporated into SMTP' until RFC7504. As of 2026-10-01, RFC7504 is the authoritative specification for SMTP 521 Reply Code.
